# Getting help with K3D

- **Documentation** - user guide, API reference and gallery: https://k3d-jupyter.org
- **Bugs and questions** - [open an issue](https://github.com/K3D-tools/K3D-jupyter/issues/new/choose).
  Include the K3D, Python and browser versions and the smallest example that shows the problem.
- **Priority support, sponsored features and integration help** for labs and companies:
  https://k3d-jupyter.org/support.html or support@k3d-jupyter.org

K3D is maintained by a very small team. Issues are answered as time allows; a
[support plan](https://k3d-jupyter.org/support.html) is the way to get a committed response time.
